markets.summary: Monday's Huang-driven rebound faded on Tuesday: the Nasdaq fell 1.5% and the S&P 500 0.5% as AI doubts returned, Nvidia dropped 7% amid questions over Trump's role in its CEO's return, and Anthropic closed below its IPO price. The sell-off spread to Asia on Wednesday, with SoftBank down 15%, while Brent crude extended its November slide despite threats in the Strait of Hormuz.
